pages.text: $(#fbe276)【Thunder】$()$(br2)Once it is hunting you, calls lightning on you every 15 s while you are within 32 blocks and in its sight (starting 5 s after it locks on).$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Latent Thunder Core, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)A copper core wound with faint arcs of lightning.$()
